title: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 5

entities.name: Quintorius Kand
entities.description: A loxodon archaeologist and planeswalker from Arcavios who stays behind with Pantlaza during the coming-of-age flight and later meets Malcolm.

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: The Sun Empire's warrior-poet and planeswalker, who claims a cosmium fragment and recites a defiant poem before battle.

entities.name: Wayta
entities.description: A young Sun Empire warrior and bat rider with an eyepatch who spots the fog and meets Malcolm again in the fight.

entities.name: Inti
entities.description: The Sun Empire's seneschal of the sun and Huatli's cousin, who duels Vito in the air and is killed.

entities.name: Caparocti
entities.description: A Sun Empire officer who rallies the troops with 'For the Threefold Sun!'

entities.name: Pantlaza
entities.description: Huatli's raptor-like dinosaur who naps while Quint watches him.

entities.name: Akal Pakal
entities.description: The Oltec steward who explains Oltec traditions and organizes the defense.

entities.name: Anim Pakal
entities.description: Akal's sister, the commander of the Thousand Moons, who brings in Amalia and Kellan for questioning.

entities.name: Chara
entities.description: An Oltec bat rider who announces Anim's approach and later warns that Chimil's prison is being remade.

entities.name: Amalia Benavides Aguirre
entities.description: A vampire who escaped Vito's rampage and warns the Oltec that the Legion seeks Aclazotz.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: A pointy-eared young man who escaped with Amalia.

entities.name: Malcolm
entities.description: A siren and Brazen Coalition pirate who escapes the Mycotyrant by singing and flies into the Core.

entities.name: Breeches
entities.description: A goblin who fights with three swords and covers his ears when Malcolm sings.

entities.name: Nicanzil
entities.description: A merfolk warrior who meets Malcolm and Breeches and says the Core must be warned.

entities.name: Mycotyrant
entities.description: A giant fungal being that speaks through the infected mayor and wants to assimilate people and ascend to the sun.

entities.name: Xavier Sal
entities.description: The infected mayor of Downtown whom the Mycotyrant uses as a puppet.

entities.name: Vito Quijano de Pasamonte
entities.description: The Legion's vampire leader who frees Aclazotz and is transformed into a bat-like monster.

entities.name: Clavileño
entities.description: Vito's soldier, transformed into a bat creature, who kills Inti.

entities.name: Aclazotz
entities.description: The imprisoned bat god of vampires, who breaks free in the Core and re-forms a sphere to imprison Chimil.

entities.name: Chimil
entities.description: The god embodied by the Core's sun, who Aclazotz means to imprison.

entities.name: Venerable Tarrian
entities.description: The author of the scriptures that guide Vito.

entities.name: Saint Elenda
entities.description: A saint Vito considers a disappointment.

entities.name: Bartolomé del Presidio
entities.description: The vampire officer Vito killed.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: Quint's friend whom he might bring to the Core.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A planeswalker known to Malcolm as an earlier off-worlder on Ixalan.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker known to Malcolm as an earlier off-worlder on Ixalan.

entities.name: The Core
entities.description: A hollow world with a central sun and a cosmium reef inside Ixalan.

entities.name: Cosmium reef
entities.description: A dangerous glowing pink trail of metal and cosmium crystals stretching from the broken shell around the sun.

entities.name: Matzalantli
entities.description: The golden door through which the fungal horde pours into the Core.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: The plane containing the Core.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: Quint's home plane.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: The university on Arcavios that Quint attended.

entities.name: Torrezon
entities.description: The vampire homeland that Vito plans to lead into a new era.

entities.name: High and Dry
entities.description: A pirate port where Malcolm knew Wayta.

entities.name: Thousand Moons
entities.description: The Oltec garrison and its soldiers who defend the valley.

entities.name: Oltec
entities.description: The people of the Core, some of whom still worship Aclazotz.

entities.name: Sun Empire
entities.description: Huatli's empire, whose warriors join the Oltec.

entities.name: River Heralds
entities.description: Merfolk who repel the fungal invasion at their city.

entities.name: Dusk Legion
entities.description: Vampires from Torrezon, many transformed into bat creatures.

entities.name: Cosmium eaters
entities.description: The long-time worshippers of Aclazotz who guide Vito and fuel his release.

entities.name: Black Rose
entities.description: A group Vito associates with Bartolomé.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Invaders whose war Wayta remembers.

entities.name: Coin Empire
entities.description: A lost civilization of interest to Quint.

entities.name: Night War
entities.description: A past Oltec war during which stories were a guiding light.

entities.name: Cosmium
entities.description: A pink crystal used in Oltec armor, weapons and devices and in the key to Aclazotz's prison.

events.summary: Quint watches Sun Empire warriors and Oltec riders prepare for a coming-of-age flight.
events.quote: He watched the Sun Empire warriors don special harnesses, supervised by members of the Thousand Moons.

events.summary: The bat riders fly toward the cosmium reef to claim cosmium.
events.quote: Huatli and the others would try to claim a piece of that cosmium for themselves.

events.summary: Akal tells Quint that stories are the memory of the plane and mentions the Night War.
events.quote: Stories are the memory of the plane, and to forget is to succumb to darkness.

events.summary: Huatli returns with a fragment of cosmium.
events.quote: I found a fragment!

events.summary: Wayta reports that the vampires have summoned a bigger cloud of cursed fog.
events.quote: The vampires have summoned a cloud of their cursed fog, bigger than usual.

events.summary: Anim brings in two prisoners, Amalia and Kellan.
events.quote: We found these two running from the garrison

events.summary: Amalia says the other vampires killed their servants and the queen's emissary and are seeking Aclazotz.
events.quote: They killed our human servants and the queen's emissary, then escaped. They're looking for Aclazotz.

events.summary: Anim and Akal react with fear, saying Aclazotz has been imprisoned for ages and some Oltec may still worship him.
events.quote: If the vampires find these allies, they may at last be powerful enough to release the bat god from his prison.

events.summary: The Mycotyrant announces it will assimilate Malcolm and Breeches and ascend to the surface.
events.quote: We will assimilate you, and we will ascend to the surface and its sun.

events.summary: Malcolm sings to stun the colony and leads Breeches toward a water tunnel.
events.quote: Taking a deep breath, Malcolm began to sing.

events.summary: The Mycotyrant breaks free of the song with a scream and the colony chases them.
events.quote: A hideous, many-mouthed scream echoed behind them.

events.summary: Malcolm and Breeches burst out above a vast ocean and the River Heralds' city.
events.quote: Without warning, the tunnel ended in a short cliff.

events.summary: The Mycotyrant's forces, including infected Downtown residents, dinosaurs and bats, erupt after them.
events.quote: The Mycotyrant's forces erupted from the tunnel.

events.summary: Merfolk defend their city against the fungal invasion with elementals.
events.quote: Merfolk drew weapons, activated the enchantments in their armor, pulled out jade totems and summoned huge elemental creatures to repel the fungal invasion.

events.summary: Nicanzil confronts Malcolm and Breeches, then agrees the Core must be warned.
events.quote: I am Nicanzil. What evil have you brought to our shores?

events.summary: Malcolm and Breeches head through the golden door to warn the Core.
events.quote: Our people beyond the golden door must be warned that it is closer than they knew.

events.summary: Vito reflects that he has taken revenge on Bartolomé and leads the vampires through the fog.
events.quote: Despite Bartolomé thwarting his intended sacrifice, he'd finally had his revenge on that thorn of the Black Rose.

events.summary: Clavileño and the soldiers hunt and feed on Oltec in the fog.
events.quote: Clavileño and the other soldiers found and silenced some, gorging themselves in an ecstasy of blood.

events.summary: A red-lit guide offers to lead Vito to Aclazotz.
events.quote: I have been sent to guide you to Aclazotz.

events.summary: Vito learns that Aclazotz is a prisoner and feels doubt, then pride.
events.quote: Vito faltered at the mention of imprisonment.

events.summary: Vito places the pink crystal key into the door, enduring pain, and the door opens.
events.quote: Crimson light spread to the glyphs around the door, and it rolled sideways with a deep rumbling sound.

events.summary: Vito enters an amphitheater of worshippers.
events.quote: a thousand pale faces turned to watch Vito enter.

events.summary: Vito sees Aclazotz chained with golden chains inlaid with cosmium crystals.
events.quote: The bat god crouched on the floor, shrouded by his wings and wrapped in loops of thick golden chains inlaid with hundreds of pink crystals.

events.summary: Aclazotz announces the end of the Fifth Age and demands sacrifices.
events.quote: The end of the Fifth Age is upon us

events.summary: The prisoners are fed to Aclazotz, and his eye brightens with each death.
events.quote: One by one, the prisoners were delivered unto the bat god, who feasted on their essences as Vito respectfully averted his gaze.

events.summary: Aclazotz breaks his golden chains.
events.quote: A concussive burst of magic struck everyone in the room as the gold links snapped in a dozen places.

events.summary: Aclazotz bites Vito and blesses the others, transforming them into bat creatures.
events.quote: In a flash, he sank them deep into Vito's neck and torso.

events.summary: The transformed vampires stand as bat-like monsters.
events.quote: Where once vampires had knelt, new creatures stood, their forms echoing their master's.

events.summary: Aclazotz leads the legion out and vows to imprison Chimil and end the Fifth Age.
events.quote: I will end the Fifth Age at last, and my children will bring the Sixth Age to the plane.

events.summary: Aclazotz reforms the shattered sphere around the sun to imprison Chimil.
events.quote: Aclazotz wielded his power to reform a shattered sphere that would soon imprison Chimil.

events.summary: The prison's shadow darkens the Core.
events.quote: The shadow of that prison fell across the land, enshrouding it in a darkness deeper than any night in Torrezon.

events.summary: Aclazotz demands more sacrifices and Vito shrieks the order to the Legion.
events.quote: I require more sacrifices. You will bring them to me.

events.summary: Wayta panics at the darkening sun and is reminded of the Phyrexian war.
events.quote: The sun darkened, and Wayta fought the urge to panic, cold sweat pooling in the small of her back.

events.summary: Wayta sees Aclazotz and the transformed vampires fly to the cosmium reef.
events.quote: led by a bat as large as three or four people standing end to end: Aclazotz.

events.summary: Chara warns that Chimil's prison is being remade.
events.quote: We must stop the betrayer Aclazotz, or Chimil will be sealed inside again.

events.summary: The Sun Empire and Oltec rally with Huatli's poem and cry 'For the Threefold Sun!'
events.quote: For the Threefold Sun!

events.summary: The vampire abominations attack the Oltec bat riders and the great battle begins.
events.quote: The vampire abominations flew toward the Oltec force.

events.summary: Wayta wounds a vampire-bat in air combat.
events.quote: Her blade tore a deep gash in her enemy's wing, and with a scream, he spun toward the earth.

events.summary: Wayta sees a siren fleeing from the door and a flood of fungal creatures behind him.
events.quote: A rush of greenish blackness poured through the portal behind him.

events.summary: Malcolm flies into the Core and finds a battle already underway.
events.quote: there appeared to be another battle already in progress.

events.summary: Malcolm and Wayta meet in the air and exchange news of the mushroom horde and the bat monsters.
events.quote: The vampires have transformed into bat monsters and their god imprisoned the sun.

events.summary: Malcolm and Wayta reach Quint, Amalia, Kellan and Akal, and Malcolm reports the Mycotyrant.
events.quote: I am Steward Akal, and you seem to have brought us more trouble.

events.summary: Akal says Anim is mobilizing the Thousand Moons, but forces will be stretched thin by two threats.
events.quote: My sister was mobilizing the Thousand Moons to mount a defense, but between this and Aclazotz, our forces will be spread thin.

events.summary: Vito impales an Oltec bat rider, who is then dragged away as a sacrifice.
events.quote: Vito dodged a wave of magic from an Oltec bat rider, then speared her through the midsection with his lance.

events.summary: Vito engages Inti in aerial combat.
events.quote: This one he remembered from the introductions among the River Heralds: Inti, seneschal of the sun.

events.summary: Clavileño grabs Inti while he is tethered to his falling bat.
events.quote: Clavileño circled behind him and gripped Inti's head in one massive claw.

events.summary: Clavileño kills Inti by snapping his neck.
events.quote: Clavileño snapped Inti's neck and both human and bat bodies fell into darkness.

events.summary: Huatli screams and dives after her fallen comrade, and Vito follows her.
events.quote: She, too, would make an excellent sacrifice.

relations.quote: Clavileño snapped Inti's neck and both human and bat bodies fell into darkness.
Before Vito could intervene, another warrior descended on him

relations.note: seeks to imprison the god of the sun
relations.quote: As I was consigned to my prison, so shall you be.
Vito trusted his god to ensure the success of his chosen saint.

relations.note: walks behind him like an honor guard
relations.quote: Clavileño and the others behind him like an honor guard.
My sister was mobilizing the Thousand Moons to mount a defense
My sister was mobilizing the Thousand Moons to mount a defense
still using Xavier as a puppet

relations.note: they meet in the air and join forces
relations.quote: Malcolm raced toward her, and she did the same

relations.note: have worshipped him since his imprisonment
relations.quote: We are the servants of Aclazotz
We must stop the betrayer Aclazotz
I'm Amalia, and this is Kellan
